name: School Crossing
spec: fluorescent yellow-green pentagon with two black children and a black diagonal-arrow plaque below
meaning: A school crossing is here; stop for children in the crosswalk.

snippets.back: Bicycle, pedestrian and school crossing signs may appear in either their older or their current colors.
Traffic control includes signals, signs, pavement markings, and directions given by police, highway workers, or school crossing guards.
When no limit is posted, the speed limit is fifteen miles per hour as you approach a school crosswalk.
Traffic is controlled by signals, signs and pavement markings, and also by police, highway workers and school crossing guards, whose directions you are required to follow.
A five-sided sign identifies a school crossing, while a diamond-shaped sign can warn of another pedestrian crossing.
A five-sided black-on-yellow sign warns only of a school or school crossing; fluorescent yellow-green may also be used.
Distraction splits into visual, manual, and cognitive kinds, texting spans all three and is illegal, and handheld use is barred in school crossings, school zones, and work zones.

Be especially watchful for children near schools, parks, playgrounds and residential areas, stop on the signal of any school crossing guard, and the law requires watching for pedestrians when turning at intersections and when entering or leaving driveways.
